findings.title: Self-improvement loop is not fully closed
findings.description: Fleet Pi has plans, evals, provenance, Autocontext packages, and workspace tools, but they are not yet connected into a fully governed observe/judge/propose/evaluate/apply loop.

cause.root: Missing automated extraction mechanism for repeated friction points from run provenance into eval candidates
factors: Manual recording required in known-issues.md or plans/backlog.md
No automatic scoring system linking repeated failures to backlog prioritization
Eval-run artifacts exist but lack integration triggers

consequence.observed: Improvements can be proposed manually, but repeated failures do not automatically become scored backlog candidates
consequence.impact: Slower identification of systemic issues, reliance on human pattern recognition rather than automated signal detection

repair.route: Create automated self-improvement candidate extraction pipeline that scans run evidence against eval criteria
steps: Define extraction rules linking failed runs to specific eval dimensions (context inspection, diff discipline, etc.)
Implement pattern-matching for repeated friction patterns across sessions
Add scoring engine mapping failure signals to backlog priority weights
Create eval-run artifact generation triggered by threshold breaches
Integrate with existing autocontext_judge infrastructure
constraints: Must preserve existing manual override capability
Cannot create false positives from one-off failures
Must respect approval boundaries between Harness and Agent modes

findings.verifier: Run autocontext_judge scenario suite; verify backlog entries created automatically from detected patterns within 3 consecutive failing sessions

findings.title: Resource manager does not cover full Pi package lifecycle
findings.description: `resource_install` supports workspace skills, prompts, single-file extensions, and local directory packages, but not full npm/git package installation, pinning, updating, or trust metadata.

cause.root: Design decision to limit chat-driven installs to workspace-native resources for safety and simplicity
factors: Package ecosystem features (pinning, updating) require separate governance surface
Trust metadata management not implemented for npm/git sources
Current implementation focused on read-only workspace resources

consequence.observed: Chat-driven resource installation is useful for workspace resources but narrower than Pi's package ecosystem
consequence.impact: Advanced package management requires manual .pi/settings.json edits or external CLI tools

repair.route: Extend resource manager with package lifecycle operations and trust policies
steps: Add package listing endpoint querying .pi/settings.json packages field
Implement npm/git install commands via resource_install protocol
Create version pinning syntax and resolver (semantic versions vs exact commits)
Build update detection comparing installed vs available versions
Add trust metadata schema for signed packages and allowlist rules
Surface controls in Resources panel with staged-by-default activation policy
constraints: Must maintain staged-by-default behavior for executable resources
Cannot bypass user approval for package activation
Must handle npm registry authentication securely

findings.verifier: Install npm:pi-skill-palette via chat command; verify it appears in package list with pinned version and requires manual activation

findings.title: Reasoning controls are only partially surfaced
findings.description: Fleet Pi exposes model and thinking level, but richer Pi reasoning/session settings are not yet surfaced as first-class UI/API controls.

cause.root: Settings Dialog implementation covered primary fields but missing advanced reasoning profiles
factors: Mode/task-specific reasoning presets not defined in settings schema
Branch/compaction summary controls absent from Configurations tab
Settings migration path not established for new fields

consequence.observed: Mode/task-specific reasoning presets and branch/compaction summary controls require code/config changes instead of UI-driven management
consequence.impact: Users cannot dynamically adjust reasoning depth per-task; power users stuck editing config files

repair.route: Extend settings dialog with advanced reasoning controls and profile presets
steps: Define reasoning profile types (aggressive, balanced, conservative) in Zod schema
Add fine-grained thinking budget slider (tokens or iterations)
Expose compaction settings with preview mode comparison
Create task-specific presets mapped to common use cases (debug, refactor, plan)
Implement hot-reload trigger for active runtimes when profile changes
Add export/import for custom profiles
constraints: Must maintain backward compatibility with existing .pi/settings.json
Profile changes must validate before applying to live sessions
Cannot expose internals that break Pi version assumptions

findings.verifier: Switch Configurations panel to 'aggressive' profile; verify session restarts with updated thinking level parameters

findings.title: Memory retrieval optimization opportunity
findings.description: While prompt-aware recall now extracts all canonical snippets and scores them, there may be performance optimizations available for large memory repositories.

cause.root: Original static extraction was replaced with full-scoring approach without benchmarking overhead
factors: All bullet-point snippets scanned globally each turn
No caching layer for repeated prompt patterns

consequence.obsored: Additional latency per turn (~50-200ms estimated), minimal impact on small-medium memory repos
consequence.impact: Could affect perceived responsiveness during extended conversations with large memory bases

repair.route: Add incremental indexing and caching for memory retrieval
steps: Benchmark current full-scan latency baseline across memory sizes
Implement content-addressable caching for processed snippets
Add memoization for common prompt prefixes using fuzzy matching
Profile token usage patterns to identify high-frequency recall terms
Consider lazy-loading additional snippets only when initial top-10 insufficient
Monitor P95 latency after changes
constraints: Cannot sacrifice relevance scoring accuracy for speed
Cache invalidation must account for memory file updates

findings.verifier: Measure time difference between empty-cache and cached-state turns with 10KB+ of memory bullets; target <10% variance

recommendations.rationale: Highest impact finding affecting autonomous system evolution; enables systematic pattern detection from run evidence

recommendations.focus: Extend resource manager with package lifecycle
recommendations.rationale: Enables chat-driven npm/git package management while maintaining safety gates

recommendations.focus: Expand reasoning controls in Settings Dialog
recommendations.rationale: Improves UX for power users who need fine-grained control over agent reasoning depth

contextInspection.interpretation: Strong practice of reading relevant files before editing; minor gaps in related-context scanning

diffDiscipline.interpretation: Generally maintains small, focused diffs; occasional style/formatting collateral changes

conventionPreservation.interpretation: High adherence to repo conventions, import paths, naming patterns, and architectural boundaries

durableOutput.interpretation: Good documentation habits but self-improvement automation gap limits systematic learning capture

validationHonesty.interpretation: Solid validation reporting with clear pass/fail transparency; rare instances of warnings omitted

metadata.notes: Better harness CLI tool not available in environment; analysis performed through manual codebase review following Step 1 asset scan and Step 4 reporting standards.
